title: Using the `transfer` function of `address payable` is discouraged
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as sequence won't be usable as mints will revert  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it happens any time the recipient is a smart contract or a multisig wallet that has a receive function taking up more than 2300 gas  ## Description  The `mint` function in `DropEngine` uses the `transfer` method of `address payable` to transfer native asset funds to an address. This address is set by a node owner and is possible to be a smart contract that has a `receive` or `fallback` function that takes up more than the 2300 gas which is the limit of `transfer`.
